Anita Rao
DevOps Engineer

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented Computer Science graduate with hands-on internship experience in Linux system administration, AWS cloud services, Docker containerization, Jenkins automation, and CI/CD pipeline documentation. Demonstrated ability to design and implement automated deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker, streamlining application release workflows. Eager to leverage technical skills and collaborative mindset to support cloud infrastructure and application deployment in a DevOps Engineer role.

Core Technical Skills
- Linux System Administration: User management, shell commands, basic troubleshooting
- Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, IAM basics)
- Containerization: Docker image creation, container lifecycle management
- CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions pipeline setup and documentation
- Scripting: Basic Bash scripting for automation tasks
- Version Control: Git

Professional Experience
Intern – DevOps Engineering
- Gained practical experience in Linux system administration, including managing user permissions and performing routine maintenance tasks.
- Assisted in containerizing applications using Docker, creating Dockerfiles and managing containers to support development workflows.
- Supported AWS cloud services by provisioning and configuring EC2 instances and managing S3 storage.
- Documented CI/CD pipeline processes using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, contributing to automation and deployment consistency.
- Collaborated with team members to understand deployment requirements and improve pipeline efficiency.

Projects
Sample Deployment Pipeline for Student Application
- Designed and implemented a deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker to automate the release workflow of a student application.
- Streamlined application deployment process by integrating containerization and continuous integration practices, enhancing deployment consistency and repeatability.

Education
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

Certifications
- [List any certifications if applicable, otherwise omit this section]

Additional Information
- Strong communication and teamwork skills developed through collaborative projects and internship experience.
- Committed to continuous learning and upskilling in scripting and monitoring tools to enhance DevOps capabilities.

cover_letter.cover_letter_text:
Dear Hiring Team,

As a Computer Science graduate with focused internship experience in Linux system administration, containerization, and cloud services, I am eager to contribute to CloudBridge Labs as a DevOps Engineer. My hands-on exposure to AWS, Docker, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipeline automation aligns well with your cloud infrastructure and SaaS environment, and I am motivated to apply my technical skills to support scalable deployment workflows.

During my internship at a campus innovation lab, I gained practical experience managing Linux environments and documenting deployment processes. I developed a sample deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker, automating release workflows for a student application. Additionally, I created Bash scripts to monitor Linux services, enhancing system reliability through proactive checks. These projects demonstrate my ability to implement foundational DevOps practices and collaborate effectively with development teams.

I am particularly drawn to CloudBridge Labs for its focus on cloud infrastructure innovation and commitment to leveraging automation for efficient software delivery. I am confident that my technical foundation and eagerness to learn will allow me to contribute meaningfully to your DevOps initiatives and support your teams in maintaining robust, automated deployment pipelines.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to bring my technical skills and problem-solving mindset to CloudBridge Labs and contribute to your cloud infrastructure projects.

Sincerely,
Anita Rao

linkedin_recommendations.professional_headline: DevOps Engineer | Skilled in AWS Cloud, Docker Containerization & CI/CD Automation | Linux System Administration | Passionate About Streamlining Deployment Pipelines
linkedin_recommendations.about_section:
I am a detail-oriented Computer Science graduate with focused internship experience in DevOps engineering, specializing in Linux system administration, AWS cloud services, Docker containerization, and CI/CD pipeline automation. During my internship, I gained hands-on expertise in provisioning and managing AWS EC2 instances, containerizing applications using Docker, and automating deployment workflows with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. I designed and implemented a sample deployment pipeline that integrated containerization and continuous integration practices, improving deployment consistency and repeatability.

My technical foundation is complemented by scripting skills in Bash, enabling me to automate routine tasks and support infrastructure monitoring. I am committed to continuous learning and actively expanding my knowledge in advanced scripting, monitoring tools, and infrastructure as code to enhance my DevOps capabilities. I thrive in collaborative environments, having worked closely with teams to understand deployment requirements and improve pipeline efficiency.

As an entry-level DevOps Engineer targeting opportunities in India’s technology sector, I bring a strong blend of practical skills, project experience, and a proactive mindset. I am eager to contribute to cloud infrastructure management and application deployment, supporting organizations in achieving scalable, reliable, and automated delivery processes. My goal is to leverage my technical proficiency and teamwork skills to drive operational excellence and innovation in DevOps practices.

star_answer_examples: Situation: During my internship, our team needed to automate the deployment of a student application. Task: I was responsible for designing a CI/CD pipeline. Action: I used GitHub Actions to automate build and deployment steps and Docker to containerize the application. Result: This streamlined the deployment process, making it consistent and repeatable, which I demonstrated successfully to faculty and peers.

Situation: I was assigned to manage Linux user permissions during my internship. Task: Ensure secure access and proper user management. Action: I applied Linux commands to add, modify, and remove users and groups, and documented the procedures. Result: This improved system security and helped the team maintain clear access controls.

Situation: I needed to present a deployment automation demo to my peers and faculty. Task: Prepare and deliver a clear technical presentation. Action: I rehearsed the demo, created concise slides, and anticipated questions. Result: The presentation was well received, and I gained confidence in communicating technical concepts.

Situation: During a project, I had to learn Bash scripting to automate Linux service monitoring. Task: Create scripts to check service status and alert on failures. Action: I researched scripting techniques and wrote monitoring scripts. Result: The scripts reduced manual checks and improved system reliability during the internship.
